decisions.quote: paula concurred that using these funds is appropriate expenditure and would support placing this on town meeting warrant to move

decisions.decision: Town Manager to investigate other office space options for the Lunenburg community coordinator, since Town Hall areas are set aside for town departments.
decisions.quote: as such the town manager is going to be investigating other options.

decisions.decision: Staff directed to take the Historical Commission's recommendations into account; the RFP for the Jones House has not been released.
decisions.quote: kerry informed her that we haven't released the rfp and we were going to take the recommendations from the historical commission.

decisions.decision: Town Manager to forward the Lake Shirley Emergency Action Plan to board members, who had not yet seen it.
decisions.quote: she will forward to board members.

decisions.decision: Lake Shirley dam maintenance to be addressed this year using funds within the budget; tree removal on private property to proceed after checking for easements.
decisions.quote: kerry and jack have heard loud and clear and there are maintenance funds within the budget and this will be addressed this year.

budget_items.topic: Jones House sale price reported in the Sentinel
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rebecca Lantry said the Sentinel reported the Jones House as sold for $10,000, which she called a misnomer because the property will be put out to bid.
budget_items.quote: as it was reported sold for $10,000 which is a total misnomer

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Facilities director estimated the porch roof repair at $1200; the tenant had agreed to make the repair the prior year but did not.
budget_items.quote: kerry had our facilities director investigate necessary repairs and has a cost estimate of $1200 to make a repair to the porch roof where

budget_items.topic: Library Oktoberfest beer and wine tasting ticket prices
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Event cost is $20 per person in advance and $25 at the door, with serving trays auctioned to raise endowment funds.
budget_items.quote: cost will be $20 per person ahead of time and $25 at the door.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: VHB reported a construction cost estimate for the Summer Street project; a board member called it a price tag without funding opportunities.
budget_items.quote: 6.3 million dollar construction cost per the estimates.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: VHB's design services have been donated to date, and funding for design services is not currently available; the board must decide whether to contribute.
budget_items.quote: at this point funding for design services is currently not available.

budget_items.topic: Summer Street cost split among communities
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A board member objected that the $460K share falls mostly on Lunenburg; VHB said the split was based on construction in each town and linear feet.
budget_items.quote: the $460k seems like we're taking the lion's share and noted that we're down hill from leominster.

budget_items.topic: Tri Town project funds for Summer Street
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager recommended using remaining Tri Town project funds for the Summer Street project as the area most impacted.
budget_items.quote: as you know we've received funds for the tri town project and her recommendation would be to use some of these funds

budget_items.topic: Special Town Meeting timing and free cash
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Concern that free cash would not be certified in time for an earlier Special Town Meeting date.
budget_items.quote: as steve voiced concern on whether we would have free cash certified in time

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Maintenance funds are within the budget and dam repairs will be addressed this year.
budget_items.quote: there are maintenance funds within the budget and this will be addressed this year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Superintendents presented proposed budgets to the regionalization committee; the final analysis showed more spending on the Lunenburg side, including legacy costs.
budget_items.quote: dave attended regionalization committee meeting last night and the superintendent's presented proposed budgets.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Salt cost increased 25%; last year's bid was $64.12 per ton and this year's bids came in at $48.56 per ton, through the Shrewsbury consortium.
budget_items.quote: last year the bid $64.12 per ton and this year we received bids for $48.56 per ton.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Three warrants were reviewed and signed with the amounts shown.
